company.name: Urent
company.shortDescription: Urent is an online platform that offers P2P marketplace for listing and renting vehicles.
company.description: Urent is a UAE-based mobility marketplace that enables users to rent and list vehicles through a digital platform. The company offers access to cars, yachts, motorcycles, scooters, and other transport options for short and long-term rentals across the MENA region. It operates a peer-to-peer and commercial rental model that connects vehicle owners, rental businesses, and customers through mobile and web applications. Urent also provides features such as booking management, host coordination, in-app communication, and fleet listing services for mobility providers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,000,000, or 66.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,678,375 to $9,931,749, a 2.7x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
